storyline.real: Hamilton leads from pole, but his tyres overheat on a hot track. He stops on lap 17 and rejoins behind Verstappen, who has not stopped yet, and can't find a way past. Ferrari keep Vettel out until lap 23: he rejoins ahead of them both and wins by 9.975 s.

eras.briefing: Melbourne, 2017. Hamilton started on pole and leads; you run Vettel second, 1.5 s behind him after 14 laps. It's hot, and the Mercedes is struggling with its tyres. Hamilton will stop first, and Verstappen, fifth, will still be out when he does.
